paite: Huan siampu a pang a, ka na sem ding a na siansakna dia hiai ahi atung ua na hih ding, bawngtalnou khat leh belampa nih gensiatbei na la ding ahi.
heading: Siampu Ding A Aaron Leh Atapate Sehdan Ding / (Lev 8.1-36)

paite: Huai ban ah tanghou silngou soh louh, tanghou beu silngou soh louh thau a zut leh tanghou pek silngou soh louh thau a zut, huit buh tangbuang in na bawl ding ahi.
Huaite loh sung ah na koih dia, bawngtal leh belampa nihte toh, loh in na hon tawi ding hi.
Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Aaron leh atapate na hon pi dia, tui in amau na sil ding ahi.
Huai khit in siampu puansilhte na la dia, puanak tung leh siampu puanaktual leh siampu puan leh awmtuam Aaron na silhsak dia, siamtak a kigan puanduang kawnggak in amah na gak ding ahi.
Alutung ah lukhu na koih dia, lukhu tung ah lallukhu siangthou na koih ding ahi.
Thau nilhchi na la dia, alutung ah na buak dia amah na nuh ding ahi.
Atapate na hon pi dia puanak tungte na silhsak ding ahi.
Kawnggak in amau na gak dia, Aaron leh atapate, lukhu bem na khusak ding hi. Omden ding dan thuseh a ding in siampu nasep amaute a ahi ding. Hichibang in Aaron leh atapate na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin ma ah bawngtal na kaisak dia; Aaron leh atapate'n bawngtal lutung ah akhutte uh anga ding uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak kiang ah, TOUPA ma ah bawngtal na gou ding ahi.
Bawngtal sisan na la dia, na khutzung in maitam kiite na nuh dia, sisan tengteng maitam bul sik ah na sungkhe ding ahi.
Asunglam tuamtu athau tengteng na la dia, asin tung a alam omleh, akailing nihte leh atung ua athau maitam tung ah na hal ding hi.
Bawngtal sa leh avun leh a-ek, giahphual polam ah mei in na hal ding hi. Hiai khelhna thillat ahi.
Belampa khat na la dia, belampa lutung ah Aaron leh atapate'n akhut uh anga ding uhi.
Belampa na that ding a, asisan na la dia, maitam kimvel in na theh ding hi.
Belampa na semnen dia, asunglam na sawpsiang dia, akhete leh asate leh alu na koihkhawm ding hi.
Belampa avek in maitam tung ah na halmang ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat gimnamtui ahi.
Belampa dang na la dia; belampa lutung ah Aaron leh atapate'n akhut uh akoih ding uhi.

Huan huai belampa na gou dia, Aaron bil taklam dawn leh atapate bil taklam dawn ah leh akhut taklam khutpi uah, akhe taklam khepi uah, asisan na la dia, na nuh ding a, maitam kimvel ah huai sisan na theh ding ahi.

Maitam tung a om sisan na la ding a, nuh theih thau toh, Aaron tung ah leh apuan tung ah leh atapate tung ah leh akiang a atapate puan tung ah na theh ding hi. Huchi in amah leh apuante leh tapate leh atapate' puante hihsiangthou ahi ding hi.
Huai Belampa thaute, amei thau, asung thau, asin leh akailing nihte leh athaute, ataklam phei toh na la ding ahi; hiai bel siangthou a sehtuamna belampa ahih ziak ahi.
TOUPA mai a lohbeu a om silngou soh louh tanghou kikoihte lak a tanghou beu khat, sathau a kikang tanghou pei khat leh tanghou kan pek khat na la dia,
Aaron khut leh atapate khut ah na koih dia; huaite TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in na vei ding hi.
Amau khut a pan huaite na sang dia, halmang thillat ding in maitam tung ah na hal ding ahi, TOUPA ma a gimlim hi ding in. Hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
Aaron hihsianthouna belampa awm na la dia, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in na vei ding hi. Hiai nang tan ding ahi.
Huai siangthou a sehtuamna belampa a pan vei thillat a veisa a-awm leh vei thillat a veisa aphei, Aaron tan leh atapate tante na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
Hiai Israel suante a pan a dan thuseh bang a Aaron leh atapate tan ngeina ahih gige ding ahi. Huai bel Israel suante'n alemna thillatte ua pan TOUPA a dia apiak ding uh ahi.
Aaron puansilh siangthoute amah nung in atapate a ahi ding uh; amaute a hihsiangthou ding leh sehkip ding in.
Ama mun a siampu hong hi atapa in Mun Siangthou a nasem dia kihoupihna biakbuk sung a alut chiang in, ni sagih sung huai puansilhte asilh ding ahi.
Kihihsianthouna belampa na la dia, mun siangthou ah asa na tuihuan ding ahi.
Aaron leh atapate'n belampa sa leh loh sung a om kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak kiang ah tanghou ane ding uhi.
Amau sehkipna ding leh hihsianthouna dia akhelhna thoihna thilte anek ding uh ahi. Thilzek leh siangthou ahih ziak in midang kuamah in anek louh ding uh ahi.
Kihihsianthouna sa hiam tanghou hiam zingsang tan a-omleh mei in na hal ding ahi. Asianthou ziak in na ne ding ahi kei.
Huchibang a thu ka hon piak bangbang in Aaron kiang ah leh atapate kiang ah na hih dia, ni sagih sung amau na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
Lemna thillat ding in niteng in bawngtal khat khelhna thillat ding in na lan ding ahi. Hiai a dia lemna na bawlzoh chiang in, maitam na hihsiang dia, thau na nilh dia, na siangthousak ding ahi,
Ni sagih sung maitam a ding in lemna na bawl dia; na hihsiangthou dia; maitam siangthoupen ahi ding. Huai maitam khoih peuhmah a sianthou ngeingei ding ahi.
Niteng a maitam tung ah kum khat a upa belamnou nih na lat gige ding ahi.
heading: Niteng Thillat / (Nam 28.1-8)

paite: Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan dia; belamnou dang khat nitaklam in na lan ding ahi.
Belamnou khat na lat chiang in tangbuang seh sawm suah seh khat, athau toh hin khat a seh lina toh dawn thillat ding in uain hin khat a seh lina na lan ding ahi.
Belamnou khat dang pen nitaklam in na lan dia, tangbuang thillat dungzui in leh dawn thillat dungzui in gimlim ding in, na hih dia, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat gimnamtui ahi.
Na khang na khang un hiai TOUPA ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a halmang thillat ahi nilouh ding ahi. Huai ah na kiang ua thu gen ding in ka hon kituahpih ding hi.
Huai ah Israel suante ka kituahpih dia, ka thupina in biakbuk ahihsiangthou ding hi.
Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam ka hihsiangthou dia; siampu a pang a kei a dia nasem ding in Aaron leh atapate leng ka hihsiangthou tuaktuak ding hi.
Huchi in Israel suante lak ah ka teng dia, a Pathian uh ka hi ding.
TOUPA a Pathian uh, alak ua ka tentheihna dia amaute Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa ka hi, chih athei ding uh. TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi.
